note: NECO Commerce round 7 (R36 top-up): aids to trade umbrella; mining and lumbering as industrial occupations; certificate of origin; FOB at the ship's rail; ad valorem duty; devaluation; demurrage; grading and standardisation; underwriting; the cover note; sum insured; USSD transfers; the ATM; gilt-edged securities; email; articles of association; the prospectus; nationalisation; face value; credit sale versus hire purchase; right to safety; the NIS mark; the reserve price; the factor who holds goods. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-6, WAEC Commerce (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
